As a full-service SEO agency in Bangladesh, we offer a complete set of services designed to cover every aspect of search engine optimization — from technical foundations to content strategy and link building.

On-Page SEO Optimization

On-page SEO plays a crucial role in helping your website rank higher and perform better. We optimize every element of your site to make it more search engine and user-friendly. This includes meta title and description optimization, keyword placement, header structure, image optimization, URL structure improvements, and content formatting. We also implement LSI keywords and structured data to strengthen topical relevance. Our on-page optimization ensures that your website sends the right signals to Google and offers a smooth experience to visitors.

Off-Page SEO and Link Building

To build domain authority and online trust, off-page SEO is essential. We use white-hat link building strategies such as guest posting, niche directory submissions, resource link acquisition, and outreach to high-quality sites. Strong backlinks improve your ranking potential and help you stay ahead of your competitors. We focus on natural, relevant, and long-lasting links that support your content strategy.

Technical SEO

A strong technical foundation is key to successful SEO. We perform comprehensive technical audits to identify and fix issues related to crawling, indexing, page speed, mobile optimization, duplicate content, and site structure. We implement XML sitemaps, optimize robots.txt, enhance site security (SSL), and improve Core Web Vitals. These steps ensure that your website is easy for both users and search engines to access and navigate.

Local SEO Services in Bangladesh

If your business targets local customers, local SEO can make a huge difference. We help you appear in Google’s local pack, Google Maps, and location-based search results. Our local SEO service includes Google Business Profile (GMB) optimization, NAP consistency, local citations, geo-targeted keyword strategy, and reputation management. This helps your business attract nearby customers actively searching for services you offer.

E-commerce SEO

For e-commerce businesses in Bangladesh, ranking product pages is crucial. We provide specialized e-commerce SEO services designed to increase product visibility and sales. Our strategies include category optimization, product title and meta improvements, schema markup implementation, URL structure optimization, and conversion-focused content. By combining technical SEO with strategic content marketing, we help your online store grow steadily.

Keyword Research and Competitor Analysis

Keyword research is at the heart of every successful SEO campaign. We identify high-traffic, low-competition keywords relevant to your niche, including long-tail and semantic search terms. In addition, we analyze your top competitors to find gaps and opportunities, ensuring that your website targets the most valuable search queries. This strategic approach increases your chances of ranking and driving qualified leads.
